verses.english: The powers of faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṁ balānaṁ etaṁ aggaṁ etaṁ saṅgāhikaṁ etaṁ saṅghātaniyaṁ, yadidaṁ paññābalaṁ.
verses.english: Of these five powers, the power of wisdom is the chief. It holds and binds everything together.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, kūṭāgārassa etaṁ aggaṁ etaṁ saṅgāhikaṁ etaṁ saṅghātaniyaṁ, yadidaṁ kūṭaṁ.
verses.english: It’s like a bungalow. The roof-peak is the chief point, which holds and binds everything together.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, imesaṁ pañcannaṁ balānaṁ etaṁ aggaṁ etaṁ saṅgāhikaṁ etaṁ saṅghātaniyaṁ, yadidaṁ paññābalan”ti.
verses.english: In the same way, of these five powers, the power of wisdom is the chief. It holds and binds everything together.”
